items.title: Physical Exercise Reduces Fall-Related Outcomes Among People With Stroke: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 18 RCTs (n=1536) found that physical exercise significantly reduced the number of falls by 39% (IRR = 0.61, 95% CI = [0.47, 0.78]) in people with stroke, with balance training and cognitive components being most effective, particularly for those in the chronic stage with mild to moderate disability.
items.curatedReason: 这份高质量系统综述和 meta 分析明确指出，卒中患者的跌倒次数可通过运动显著减少39%。在治疗方案中优先纳入平衡训练和认知成分。对处于慢性期、轻中度功能障碍的患者，这套方案的疗效尤其显著，临床上应立即采纳。
items.titleZh: 体育锻炼能减少卒中患者跌倒相关结局：一项系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 18 项 RCT（n=1536）的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，体育锻炼能显著减少卒中患者跌倒次数 39%（IRR = 0.61, 95% CI = [0.47, 0.78]），其中平衡训练和认知成分的方案效果最佳，尤其适用于慢性期且轻中度功能障碍的患者。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-quality systematic review and meta-analysis definitively shows exercise can reduce falls by 39% in stroke patients. Prioritize balance training and cognitive components in your intervention designs. This approach is particularly effective for those in the chronic stage with mild-to-moderate disability, and you should implement it now.
items.limitation: 子组分析为探索性质，结果需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: Subgroup analyses were exploratory, and results require further validation.

items.title: Effects of Using High-Frequency TENS During an Exercise Therapy Program in Knee Osteoarthritis: A Randomized Sham-Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized, sham-controlled trial (n=96) found that adding high-frequency transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation (TENS) to an exercise therapy program provided no additional benefit over sham stimulation for knee osteoarthritis, with an adjusted mean difference of 1.05 points (95% CI, -5.19 to 7.29) on the KOOS Pain subscale post-intervention.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 研究显示，对于膝骨关节炎患者，在高频 TENS 之外叠加运动疗法并无额外益处。在评估膝骨关节炎的干预方案时，应优先考虑有更强证据支持的疗法。
items.titleZh: 高频 TENS 在膝骨关节炎运动疗法中的效果：一项随机假对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机假对照试验（n=96）发现，在膝骨关节炎患者的运动疗法中加入高频经皮电神经刺激（TENS）并未比假刺激带来额外益处，干预后 KOOS 疼痛分量表的调整平均差异为 1.05 分（95% CI, -5.19 to 7.29）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT shows that adding high-frequency TENS to exercise therapy offers no additional benefit for knee osteoarthritis patients. When evaluating interventions for knee osteoarthritis, prioritize therapies with stronger evidence.
items.limitation: 研究未进行正式的盲法评估，随访期短，且缺乏单纯运动组作为对照。
items.limitationEn: The study lacked formal blinding assessment, had a short follow-up, and did not include an exercise-only group for comparison.

items.title: Implementation of group-based health education and exercise for individuals with knee osteoarthritis in brazilian primary health care: a mixed-methods study.
items.summary: A mixed-methods implementation study (n=84) in Brazilian primary care found that a physical therapist-led, group-based exercise and health education program for knee osteoarthritis was feasible and well-accepted, with high recruitment (87.3%), retention (83%), and adherence, and exploratory clinical outcomes suggesting improvements in pain and function.
items.curatedReason: 这项混合方法研究表明，在巴西初级保健中由 PT 主导的膝骨关节炎团体运动和健康教育方案是可行的。这提示了在资源受限地区推广循证干预的潜力，可作为你探索类似社区项目时的参考。
items.titleZh: 巴西初级卫生保健中膝骨关节炎团体健康教育和运动实施的混合方法研究
items.summaryZh: 一项在巴西初级保健中进行的混合方法实施研究（n=84）发现，由物理治疗师主导的膝骨关节炎团体运动和健康教育方案具有可行性和高接受度，招募率（87.3%）、留存率（83%）和依从性均高，探索性临床结果提示疼痛和功能有所改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This mixed-methods study shows that PT-led group exercise and health education for knee osteoarthritis is feasible in Brazilian primary care. This suggests potential for scaling evidence-based interventions in resource-limited settings and can inform your exploration of similar community programs.
items.limitation: 本研究为实施研究，主要关注可行性，其临床结果为探索性质，而非随机对照试验的疗效验证。
items.limitationEn: This is an implementation study focused primarily on feasibility; its clinical outcomes are exploratory and do not provide efficacy validation like an RCT.

items.title: Association Between Therapeutic Education Delivered by a Community Post-Stroke Rehabilitation Team and Improvement in the Frenchay Activities Index: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study (n=163) found that stroke survivors participating in home-based therapeutic patient education (TPE) delivered by a Community Stroke Rehabilitation Team showed greater improvement in Frenchay Activities Index scores (mean change: 6.02 ± 8.22) compared to standard care, with additional benefits when TPE included physical activity workshops.
items.curatedReason: 这项回顾性队列研究提示，由社区卒中康复团队提供的居家治疗性教育（尤其是结合体育活动）与卒中后社会参与的改善相关。这支持了在社区康复中融入教育和运动元素的价值，但仍需前瞻性研究来确证因果。
items.titleZh: 社区卒中康复团队提供的治疗性教育与 Frenchay 活动指数改善的关联：一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究（n=163）发现，参与社区卒中康复团队提供居家治疗性教育（TPE）的卒中幸存者在 Frenchay 活动指数评分上有更大改善（平均变化：6.02 ± 8.22），若 TPE 包含体育活动工作坊则益处更明显。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective cohort study suggests that home-based therapeutic education (especially with physical activity) delivered by community stroke rehabilitation teams is associated with improved social participation post-stroke. This supports the value of integrating education and exercise in community rehab, but prospective studies are needed to confirm causality.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列研究，可能存在混杂因素，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective cohort study may have confounders and cannot establish causality.

items.title: Immediate and fatigue-related effects of subtalar sling taping in individuals with chronic ankle instability.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=90) comparing rigid, Kinesio, and sham subtalar sling taping in chronic ankle instability found outcome-dependent and time-point-specific effects post-taping and post-fatigue, with no consistent superiority between rigid and Kinesio taping, though Kinesio taping showed higher Y-Balance Test scores than sham post-fatigue.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 发现，对于慢性踝关节不稳患者，刚性或肌内效贴扎在疲劳后对平衡和跳跃表现有特定、非一致性的效果。在决定临床使用时，你需要根据具体结局指标和时间点来评估贴扎的潜在价值。
items.titleZh: 慢性踝关节不稳患者距下关节吊带贴扎的即时和疲劳相关影响
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=90）比较了慢性踝关节不稳患者的刚性、肌内效和假距下关节吊带贴扎，发现贴扎后和疲劳后效果因结局指标和时间点而异，刚性与肌内效贴扎之间无持续优势，但肌内效贴扎在疲劳后 Y 平衡测试得分高于假贴扎。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that rigid or Kinesio subtalar sling taping had specific, inconsistent effects on balance and hop performance after fatigue in chronic ankle instability. When deciding on clinical use, you need to evaluate the potential value of taping based on specific outcomes and time points.
items.limitation: 不同贴扎方式在不同结局和时间点上的效果不一致，提示其普适性可能有限。
items.limitationEn: Inconsistent effects of different taping methods across various outcomes and time points suggest limited generalizability.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Motor-Based Interventions in Children with Developmental Coordination Disorder: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Randomised Controlled Trials - Sports Medicine - Open
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis (32 RCTs) found that motor-based interventions significantly improved overall motor skills (g=1.00), balance (g=0.57), cognitive function (g=1.53), and activity performance (g=0.71) in children with Developmental Coordination Disorder, with task-oriented and combined approaches showing superior effects.
items.curatedReason: 这项高质量系统综述和 meta 分析坐实了运动干预能显著改善发育性协调障碍（DCD）儿童的运动技能、平衡、认知和活动表现。这为你的临床实践提供了强有力的证据，尤其提示任务导向训练和结合任务-过程导向训练的优越性，帮助你优化 DCD 儿童的康复方案。
items.titleZh: 发育性协调障碍儿童的运动干预：随机对照试验的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析（32 项 RCT）发现，运动干预显著改善了发育性协调障碍儿童的整体运动技能（g=1.00）、平衡（g=0.57）、认知功能（g=1.53）和活动表现（g=0.71），其中任务导向和结合任务-过程导向的方法显示出更优的效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-quality systematic review and meta-analysis confirms that motor-based interventions significantly improve motor skills, balance, cognition, and activity performance in children with Developmental Coordination Disorder (DCD), highlighting the superiority of task-oriented and combined approaches. This provides strong evidence for optimizing rehabilitation protocols for children with DCD.
items.limitation: 研究未能观察到运动干预对儿童参与水平的改善，也未对心理社会因素产生统计学显著效应，提示在这些领域仍需更全面的干预策略。
items.limitationEn: The study did not observe improvements in children's participation levels, nor did it show statistically significant effects on psychosocial factors, suggesting that more comprehensive intervention strategies are needed in these areas.

items.title: The Effects of Exergames on Fundamental Movement Skills in Childhood: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis (12 studies, 17 comparisons) found that low-barrier exergames are as effective as traditional activity for fundamental movement skills adaptation in children, with variability in effects explained by coaching and activity structure rather than exergame status.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述和 meta 分析提供了确凿证据，表明低门槛的体感游戏（exergames）在改善儿童基本运动技能方面与传统活动同样有效。这支持你将体感游戏整合到儿童运动康复和体能训练中，尤其在克服实际障碍和激发运动兴趣方面具有独特优势。
items.titleZh: 体感游戏对儿童基本运动技能的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析（12 项研究，17 项比较）发现，低门槛体感游戏对儿童基本运动技能的适应性与传统活动同样有效，其效果的变异性由教练指导和活动结构解释，而非体感游戏本身。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis provides definitive evidence that low-barrier exergames are as effective as traditional activities in improving fundamental movement skills in children. This supports your integration of exergames into pediatric motor rehabilitation, especially given their advantages in overcoming practical barriers and motivating physical activity.
items.limitation: 研究强调了教练指导和活动结构是影响体感游戏效果的关键因素，但对具有模拟教练或协同教学系统的体感游戏形式，仍需更多研究来明确其基本运动技能效果。
items.limitationEn: The study highlights coaching and activity structure as key factors influencing exergame effectiveness, but more research is needed to determine the fundamental movement skills effects of exergame forms with simulated coaching or co-teaching systems.

items.title: APTA Presses for Inclusion of CPT Codes in UHC Prior Authorization Reforms
items.summary: APTA is advocating for the inclusion of commonly used CPT codes in UnitedHealthcare's prior authorization reforms after UHC's recent announcement eliminated 30% of requirements but excluded physical therapy services, highlighting ongoing efforts for prior authorization reduction.
items.curatedReason: 美国物理治疗协会 (APTA) 正推动将常用的 CPT 代码纳入联合健康保险 (UHC) 的预授权改革中，以减少物理治疗服务的行政障碍。这直接影响你在美国市场的报销和执业效率，需密切关注 APTA 的后续行动。
items.titleZh: APTA 敦促将 CPT 代码纳入 UHC 预授权改革
items.summaryZh: 在美国联合健康保险 (UHC) 最近宣布削减 30% 预授权要求但未包含物理治疗服务后，APTA 正积极倡导将常用的 CPT 代码纳入 UHC 的预授权改革，以推动预授权要求的进一步简化。
items.curatedReasonEn: The American Physical Therapy Association (APTA) is pushing for the inclusion of commonly used CPT codes in UnitedHealthcare's (UHC) prior authorization reforms to reduce administrative barriers for physical therapy services. This directly impacts your reimbursement and practice efficiency in the U.S. market, and you should closely monitor APTA's follow-up actions.

items.title: Is therapeutic exercise as a standalone intervention effective in reducing kinesiophobia in adults with nonspecific chronic low back pain? A systematic review and meta-analysis with meta-regression.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis (8 RCTs, n=854) found that standalone exercise significantly reduced kinesiophobia in adults with non-specific chronic low back pain (MD = -5.38; 95% CI -7.63 to -3.13; SMD = -1.03) compared to passive controls and usual care, exceeding the minimal clinically important difference, despite considerable heterogeneity.
items.curatedReason: 这项高质量系统综述和 meta 分析证实，单独运动疗法能显著降低非特异性慢性腰痛患者的运动恐惧，且效应量超过临床最小重要差异。这进一步支持了运动作为管理慢性腰痛、改善心理社会因素的核心干预地位。
items.titleZh: 治疗性运动作为单一干预措施是否能有效降低非特异性慢性腰痛成人患者的运动恐惧症？一项系统综述和荟萃分析与荟萃回归
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析（8 项 RCT，n=854）发现，与被动对照和常规护理相比，单独的运动疗法显著降低了非特异性慢性腰痛成人患者的运动恐惧症（MD = -5.38；95% CI -7.63 至 -3.13；SMD = -1.03），且效应量超过临床最小重要差异，尽管研究间存在显著异质性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-quality systematic review and meta-analysis confirms that standalone therapeutic exercise significantly reduces kinesiophobia in adults with non-specific chronic low back pain, with an effect size exceeding the minimal clinically important difference. It's time to solidify exercise as a core intervention for managing chronic low back pain and improving psychosocial factors.
items.limitation: 尽管存在显著效应，但各研究间存在高度异质性（I² ≈ 94%），且证据确定性被评为低，提示结果需谨慎解释，不能视为所有人群和干预措施的普遍效应。
items.limitationEn: Despite significant effects, high heterogeneity (I² ≈ 94%) and low certainty of evidence were observed across studies, suggesting that the results should be interpreted cautiously and not as a universal effect across all populations and interventions.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: Alignment between goals and subjective memory concerns in measuring outcomes of memory rehabilitation post-stroke.
items.summary: A sub-study (n=38) nested within the Memory-SuSTAIN trial found that goal-consistent subjective memory concerns in stroke survivors significantly improved (reduced by 7.68 points) after a Stroke Memory Skills Group intervention, whereas goal-inconsistent concerns did not, suggesting tailored outcome measurement can optimize rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，对齐患者的主观记忆障碍与康复目标，可以更敏感地追踪卒中后记忆康复的疗效。这提醒你，在神经康复中，个体化目标设定与评估对于更精确地衡量干预效果至关重要。
items.titleZh: 卒中后记忆康复效果测量中目标与主观记忆关注的一致性
items.summaryZh: Memory-SuSTAIN 试验的一项子研究（n=38）发现，卒中幸存者中与目标一致的主观记忆问题在卒中记忆技能小组干预后显著改善（减少 7.68 分），而与目标不一致的问题则无此变化，提示量身定制的结局测量可优化康复效果评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that aligning subjective memory concerns with rehabilitation goals can more sensitively track the efficacy of post-stroke memory rehabilitation. This highlights the importance of individualized goal setting and assessment in neurological rehabilitation for more precise measurement of intervention effects.
items.limitation: 这是一项嵌套在较大试验中的亚研究，样本量较小（38 名卒中幸存者），且随访期相对较短（24 周），可能限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This is a sub-study nested within a larger trial, with a small sample size (38 stroke survivors) and a relatively short follow-up period (24 weeks), which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title:
Age, resilience, social support, and health literacy as predictors of functional ability in people with spinal cord injury: a 6-month follow-up study
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A 6-month follow-up study (n=367) on traumatic spinal cord injury patients found that younger age (β = –0.02; p = 0.028), higher resilience (β = 0.22; p < 0.001), and higher health literacy (β = 0.32; p = 0.001) were significant independent predictors of greater functional ability.
items.curatedReason: 这项随访研究强调，年轻、高心理韧性和高健康素养是脊髓损伤患者术后 6 个月内功能恢复的独立预测因子。这提示你应将这些可调节的心理社会和认知资源纳入康复策略，以期优化功能预后。
items.titleZh: 年龄、心理韧性、社会支持和健康素养作为脊髓损伤患者功能能力的预测因子：一项 6 个月随访研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对创伤性脊髓损伤患者的 6 个月随访研究（n=367）发现，年龄较小（β = –0.02；p = 0.028）、心理韧性较高（β = 0.22；p < 0.001）和健康素养较高（β = 0.32；p = 0.001）是功能能力较强的显著独立预测因子。
items.curatedReasonEn: This follow-up study highlights that younger age, higher psychological resilience, and higher health literacy are independent predictors of functional recovery within 6 months post-spinal cord injury. This suggests you should integrate these modifiable psychosocial and cognitive resources into rehabilitation strategies to optimize functional outcomes.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心观察性研究（n=367），结果可能受限于中国西南地区，且研究中的功能能力改善幅度较小，其临床意义仍需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center observational study (n=367), and the results may be limited to Southwest China. Furthermore, the modest improvement in functional ability observed in the study requires further validation for its clinical significance.

related.title: Age, resilience, social support, and health literacy as predictors of functional ability in people with spinal cord injury: a 6-month follow-up study.

items.title: Multimodal high-intensity interval training elicits greater improvements in aerobic capacity and sprint performance versus small-sided games and drill-based HIIT in adolescent basketball players: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=36 adolescent male basketball players) found that multimodal HIIT (M-HIIT) elicited significantly greater improvements in estimated VO₂max (+10.9%), 20-m sprint time (-5.1%), and RSA fatigue resistance (-7.39 points) compared to small-sided games and drill-based HIIT.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 表明，在青少年篮球运动员中，多模式高强度间歇训练（M-HIIT）在提高有氧能力、冲刺表现和抗疲劳能力方面优于传统的小场比赛和基于训练的 HIIT。这提示你应考虑将 M-HIIT 整合到青少年运动员的训练计划中，以更高效地优化生理和专项表现。
items.titleZh: 多模式高强度间歇训练在青少年篮球运动员中比小场比赛和基于训练的 HIIT 能更显著改善有氧能力和冲刺表现：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=36 名男性青少年篮球运动员）发现，多模式高强度间歇训练（M-HIIT）比小场比赛和基于训练的 HIIT 能更显著地提高最大摄氧量估值（+10.9%）、20 米冲刺时间（-5.1%）和重复冲刺能力抗疲劳性（-7.39 分）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT indicates that multimodal high-intensity interval training (M-HIIT) is superior to traditional small-sided games and drill-based HIIT in improving aerobic capacity, sprint performance, and fatigue resistance in adolescent basketball players. This suggests you should consider integrating M-HIIT into youth athlete training programs to optimize physiological and sport-specific outcomes more efficiently.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（36 名男性青少年篮球运动员），且仅在 6 周内进行，因此结果的长期效果和对其他运动或女性运动员的普适性可能需要进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (36 male adolescent basketball players) and was conducted over only 6 weeks, so the long-term effects and generalizability to other sports or female athletes may require further research.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Neurophysiological and neuromuscular responses associated with the repeated bout effect following eccentric exercise in healthy adults: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 12 studies on the repeated bout effect (RBE) following eccentric exercise found that peripheral contractile outcomes showed the most consistent recovery-compatible pattern at 24h (g=1.02) and 48h (g=0.50), while evidence for central activation and motor-unit behavior was limited or inconsistent.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述和 meta 分析评估了重复离心运动效应（RBE）相关的神经生理和神经肌肉反应。它指出外周收缩性指标恢复模式最一致，而中枢激活和运动单元行为的证据有限或不一致。这意味着 RBE 的机制仍不完全明确，你在设计基于离心运动的预防策略时需考虑这一局限。
items.titleZh: 健康成人离心运动后重复训练效应相关的神经生理和神经肌肉反应：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 12 项关于离心运动后重复训练效应（RBE）的研究进行的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，外周收缩性结局在 24 小时（g=1.02）和 48 小时（g=0.50）表现出最一致的恢复兼容模式，而中枢激活和运动单位行为的证据则有限或不一致。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis indicates that the mechanisms of the repeated bout effect (RBE) following eccentric exercise are not fully elucidated, with peripheral contractile outcomes showing the most consistent recovery pattern, while evidence for central activation is limited. When designing eccentric exercise-based prevention strategies, be aware of this uncertainty and consider combining approaches.
items.limitation: 鉴于纳入研究数量较少，所有汇总分析均被认为是探索性的，这限制了对神经生理和神经肌肉机制的明确理解。
items.limitationEn: Given the small number of contributing studies, all pooled analyses were considered exploratory, which limits a definitive understanding of neurophysiological and neuromuscular mechanisms.

items.title: Adding the short, digital PainSMART-educational strategy whilst patients with musculoskeletal pain wait for primary care physiotherapy: A randomised controlled trial.
items.summary: A multi-center RCT (n=504) found that adding a 7-minute digital PainSMART-educational strategy did not provide additional clinically meaningful benefits once physiotherapy commenced for musculoskeletal pain, but it may facilitate earlier improvements in pain perceptions, self-efficacy, and physical activity during waiting times.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 提示，在患者等待物理治疗期间提供数字疼痛科学教育，可能有助于改善早期疼痛感知、自我效能和身体活动水平。虽然并未替代正式治疗后的临床效益，但可作为你利用候诊期介入的辅助工具。
items.titleZh: 在肌肉骨骼疼痛患者等待初级物理治疗期间，增加简短的数字 PainSMART 教育策略：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心随机对照试验（n=504）发现，对于肌肉骨骼疼痛患者，在标准物理治疗管理中加入 7 分钟的数字 PainSMART 教育策略，在物理治疗开始后并未带来额外的临床有益效果，但在等待期内可能促进疼痛感知、自我效能和身体活动方面的早期改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that providing digital pain science education to patients while they await physiotherapy may help improve early pain perception, self-efficacy, and physical activity levels. While not a substitute for clinical benefits after formal treatment, it can be a useful adjunct for interventions during waiting periods.
items.limitation: 研究未发现 PainSMART 策略在物理治疗开始后带来额外的临床有意义益处，且分析能力可能不足以检测所有次要结局的显著差异。
items.limitationEn: The study found no additional clinically meaningful benefits from the PainSMART strategy once physiotherapy had commenced, and the analysis may have been underpowered to detect significant differences in all secondary outcomes.

items.title: Autonomic responses to repeated locomotor perturbations in older adults: dissociation between phasic habituation and sustained tonic arousal.
items.summary: A study (n=18 older adults) found that repeated slip perturbations during walking elicit a phasic sympathetic nervous system (SNS) response that habituates, while tonic SNS activity remains elevated. A change in perturbation direction restores the phasic response, suggesting benefits for perturbation-based balance training.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，老年人在行走时经历平衡扰动会激活交感神经系统，且其生理反应会随着重复扰动而习惯。这意味着基于扰动的平衡训练对老年人是可行的，并可能通过适应性反应来提高步态稳定性。
items.titleZh: 老年人对重复步态扰动的自主神经反应：阶段性习惯化与持续性紧张性觉醒的分离
items.summaryZh: 一项对 18 名老年人的研究发现，行走过程中重复的滑倒扰动会引起阶段性的交感神经系统（SNS）反应并逐渐习惯，但紧张性 SNS 活动保持升高。改变扰动方向会恢复阶段性反应，提示基于扰动的平衡训练对老年人有益。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that older adults' sympathetic nervous system activates in response to balance perturbations during walking, and this physiological response habituates with repeated exposure. This suggests that perturbation-based balance training is feasible for older adults and may enhance gait stability through adaptive responses.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（18 名老年人），且所有扰动均在同一方向进行（除一次反向），这可能限制了结果推广至更复杂或多方向扰动的适用性。
items.limitationEn: The study involved a small sample size (18 older adults), and all perturbations were applied in the same direction (except for one reverse perturbation), which may limit the generalizability of the findings to more complex or multi-directional perturbations.
items.journal: Journal of electromyography and kinesiology : official journal of the International Society of Electrophysiological Kinesiology

items.title: Test-Retest Reliability of an Isometric Trunk Flexor and Extensor Test in Community-Dwelling Adults
items.summary: A study (n=29 healthy adults) found excellent test-retest reliability for isometric trunk flexion (ICC 0.92) and extension (ICC 0.93) strength measurements using the VALD ForceFrame Strength Testing System, with minimum detectable changes of 71.35N and 101.20N, respectively.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究提示，VALD ForceFrame 系统测量躯干屈伸等长力量时具有出色的重测可靠性，可作为监测脊柱病理患者进展的潜在工具，但样本量小，需谨慎解读。
items.titleZh: 社区居住成人等长躯干屈伸试验的重测可靠性
items.summaryZh: 一项研究（n=29 名健康成人）发现，使用 VALD ForceFrame 力量测试系统测量等长躯干屈曲（ICC 0.92）和伸展（ICC 0.93）力量具有出色的重测可靠性，最小可检测变化分别为 71.35N 和 101.20N。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests the VALD ForceFrame system demonstrates excellent test-retest reliability for measuring isometric trunk flexion and extension strength, potentially serving as a tool for monitoring progress in patients with spinal pathologies. However, the small sample size warrants cautious interpretation.
items.limitation: 研究对象为健康的社区居住成人（n=29），结果可能无法直接推广到有脊柱病理的患者群体。
items.limitationEn: The study involved healthy community-dwelling adults (n=29), and the results may not be directly generalizable to patient populations with spinal pathologies.

items.title: Pelvic morphology decoupling from lumbar lordosis in chronic low back pain
items.summary: An observational study (n=144) found that chronic low back pain (CLBP) patients showed a decoupling of lumbar lordosis from pelvic morphology (r=-0.137, p=0.251 in CLBP vs. r=-0.428, p<0.001 in volunteers), with a threefold amplification of the sacral base angle-lordosis relationship, suggesting pelvic retroversion and lordosis flattening.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究揭示，慢性腰痛患者的腰椎前凸与骨盆形态之间的耦合关系被打破，且骶骨基底角对腰椎前凸的影响被放大三倍。这提示你在评估慢性腰痛时，应更关注骨盆姿态及其对腰椎前凸的代偿性影响，以指导个体化的矢状位康复策略。
items.titleZh: 慢性腰痛中腰椎前凸与骨盆形态的解耦
items.summaryZh: 一项观察性研究（n=144）发现，慢性腰痛（CLBP）患者的腰椎前凸与骨盆形态之间存在解耦现象（CLBP 患者 r=-0.137，p=0.251；志愿者 r=-0.428，p<0.001），且骶骨基底角与腰椎前凸的关系被放大三倍，提示骨盆后倾和腰椎前凸变平。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study reveals that the coupling between lumbar lordosis and pelvic morphology is disrupted in chronic low back pain patients, with the sacral base angle's influence on lumbar lordosis amplified threefold. This suggests that when assessing chronic low back pain, you should pay more attention to pelvic posture and its compensatory effects on lumbar lordosis to guide individualized sagittal rehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 这是一项观察性研究，不能建立因果关系，且基于横断面影像数据，无法捕捉动态变化；尽管进行了年龄和性别调整，但样本量相对有限（n=144），可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational study that cannot establish causality and is based on cross-sectional imaging data, thus unable to capture dynamic changes. Despite age and sex adjustments, the sample size is relatively limited (n=144), which may affect the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: The impact of COVID-19 lockdown measures on cognition and physical function of older adults in long term care facilities: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review (12 cohort studies, n=168,911 LTCF residents) found good evidence of no increased worsening of cognition or ADL dependency due to COVID-19 lockdown measures, but low-quality evidence suggested an increased percentage of residents with falls, with rates of falls likely rising.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述表明，COVID-19 封锁措施似乎并未显著加剧长期照护机构老年人的认知和身体功能下降，但可能增加了跌倒风险。这提示你在未来应对类似公共卫生危机时，应在感染控制与老年人活动需求之间取得平衡，尤其要关注跌倒预防。
items.titleZh: COVID-19 封锁措施对长期照护机构老年人认知和身体功能的影响：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述（12 项队列研究，n=168,911 名长期照护机构居民）发现，有充分证据表明 COVID-19 封锁措施并未加剧认知或 ADL 依赖的恶化，但低质量证据提示跌倒居民的比例有所增加，跌倒率可能上升。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review indicates that COVID-19 lockdown measures did not significantly worsen cognitive and physical function in older adults in long-term care facilities but might have increased fall risk. This suggests that when facing similar public health crises in the future, you should balance infection control with older adults' activity needs, particularly focusing on fall prevention.
items.limitation: 尽管涵盖了大量居民，但证据质量在某些结局上为低至中等，且缺乏关于谵妄、衰弱或肌少症影响的充分证据，长期影响仍需更多研究。
items.limitationEn: Despite covering a large number of residents, the evidence quality for some outcomes was low to moderate, and there was insufficient evidence on the impact on delirium, frailty, or sarcopenia, with long-term effects requiring further research.

items.title: A pilot randomized trial of a solution-focused, telehealth-supported transitional care program in older adults with heart failure
items.summary: A pilot RCT (n=56 older adults with heart failure) found that a solution-focused, telehealth-supported transitional care program was feasible and acceptable, demonstrating improved discharge preparation, transitional care quality, and quality of life at 30 and 90 days post-discharge (p < 0.05).
items.curatedReason: 这项初步 RCT 结果显示，结合解决方案焦点、远程医疗支持的过渡期照护项目，对于心力衰竭老年人是可行且可接受的，并可能改善其出院准备、照护质量和生活质量。这提示你可以在心肺康复中探索远程医疗支持下的综合照护模式，但其效果仍需大规模试验验证。
items.titleZh: 一项针对心力衰竭老年人的以解决方案为中心、远程医疗支持的过渡期照护项目的初步随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项初步随机对照试验（n=56 名心力衰竭老年人）发现，以解决方案为中心、远程医疗支持的过渡期照护项目是可行且可接受的，并在出院后 30 和 90 天改善了出院准备、过渡期照护质量和生活质量（p < 0.05）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT suggests that a solution-focused, telehealth-supported transitional care program for older adults with heart failure is feasible and acceptable, and may improve discharge preparation, transitional care quality, and quality of life. This indicates that you can explore telehealth-supported integrated care models in cardiopulmonary rehabilitation, though their effectiveness still requires large-scale trial validation.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步随机对照试验，样本量较小（56 名患者），且未观察到对再入院率、门诊或急诊就诊次数的显著影响，其长期临床效益需大规模试验进一步确认。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot randomized controlled trial with a small sample size (56 patients), and no significant differences were observed in readmissions, outpatient, or emergency room visits, with long-term clinical benefits requiring confirmation in larger trials.

items.title: Short-Term Effects of Radial Extracorporeal Shock Wave Therapy in Addition to Physiotherapy on Spasticity, Walking Performance, and Quality of Life in Chronic Stroke: A Sham-Controlled Randomized Trial.
items.summary: A 4-week program of radial extracorporeal shock wave therapy (rESWT) combined with physiotherapy significantly improved spasticity (-0.56 MAS; 95% CI -0.77 to -0.35), walking performance (-1.41 s 10MWT; -1.87 to -0.96), motor function, and quality of life in chronic stroke patients with plantar flexor spasticity compared to sham treatment.
items.curatedReason: 这项高质量的随机对照试验表明，在慢性卒中患者的标准物理治疗中加入为期 4 周的径向体外冲击波疗法，能显著改善痉挛、步行能力、运动功能和生活质量。这一发现支持了将 rESWT 作为辅助手段纳入卒中康复方案，以获得短期临床益处。
items.titleZh: 径向体外冲击波疗法联合物理治疗对慢性卒中患者痉挛、步行表现和生活质量的短期效果：一项假对照随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 4 周的径向体外冲击波疗法 (rESWT) 联合物理治疗项目，在慢性卒中患者中，显著改善了痉挛 (-0.56 MAS)、步行表现 (-1.41 秒 10MWT)、运动功能和生活质量，优于假治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-quality RCT shows that adding 4 weeks of radial extracorporeal shock wave therapy to standard physiotherapy significantly improves spasticity, walking performance, motor function, and quality of life in chronic stroke patients. This finding supports integrating rESWT as an adjunct in stroke rehabilitation protocols for short-term clinical benefits.
items.limitation: 研究仅评估了短期效果，长期疗效和安全性仍需进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: The study only assessed short-term effects; long-term efficacy and safety require further investigation.

items.title: CMS Refocuses Medicaid Quality on Health Outcomes, Launches Innovative Partnership With 37 States
items.summary: CMS is refocusing Medicaid quality on health outcomes and launching an innovative partnership with 37 states to improve care delivery. This initiative aims to enhance the accountability of Medicaid programs by prioritizing measurable improvements in patient health.
items.curatedReason: 美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心 (CMS) 宣布将 Medicaid 质量衡量重新聚焦于健康结果，并与 37 个州启动创新伙伴关系。这代表了美国医疗补助政策的重大转向，预示着未来报销模式和质量指标可能发生变化，直接影响物理治疗师在 Medicaid 服务中的执业与报销策略。
items.titleZh: 阅读更多关于 CMS 将 Medicaid 质量重新聚焦于健康结果，并与 37 个州启动创新伙伴关系
items.summaryZh: CMS 正将 Medicaid 的质量重点重新放在健康结果上，并与 37 个州启动一项创新伙伴关系，以改善医疗服务。该倡议旨在通过优先考虑患者健康的可衡量改进来增强 Medicaid 项目的问责制。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) announced a refocusing of Medicaid quality measures on health outcomes and an innovative partnership with 37 states. This represents a significant shift in US Medicaid policy, signaling potential changes in reimbursement models and quality metrics, directly impacting physical therapists' practice and billing strategies within Medicaid services.

items.title: Peripheral arterial disease: adverse impacts, disparities in outcomes, and the path ahead.
items.summary: The third paper in the peripheral arterial disease (PAD) Series details the devastating individual impacts of PAD, including chronic pain and functional limitation, highlights disparities in outcomes for underserved groups, and offers recommendations for advancing PAD management, including multidisciplinary care models.
items.curatedReason: 这份 PAD 系列文章的第三篇，深入探讨了外周动脉疾病对个体和弱势群体造成的严重影响，并提出了改善管理和医疗服务公平性的建议，对于拓展物理治疗师对 PAD 患者整体需求的理解，以及关注医疗公平性有重要意义。
items.titleZh: 外周动脉疾病：不良影响、结果差异及未来之路
items.summaryZh: 外周动脉疾病 (PAD) 系列的第三篇论文详细阐述了 PAD 对个体的毁灭性影响，包括慢性疼痛和功能受限，强调了弱势群体在结果上的差异，并提出了推进 PAD 管理的建议，包括多学科护理模式。
items.curatedReasonEn: This third paper in the PAD series deeply explores the severe impacts of peripheral arterial disease on individuals and underserved groups, and proposes recommendations to improve management and healthcare equity. It is significant for expanding physical therapists' understanding of the holistic needs of PAD patients and addressing healthcare equity.

items.title: Get trained, save lives: turning a mega sport event into a CPR training platform
items.summary: This commentary discusses how major sporting events, like the Christian Eriksen collapse at Euro 2020, can serve as platforms to promote CPR training, advocating for a shift from mere awareness campaigns to integrated health system pathways that equip spectators with actual life-saving skills.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评通过 Christian Eriksen 事件引出了大型体育赛事作为 CPR 培训平台的潜力，强调了从提高意识转向实际技能培训的必要性。这为物理治疗师参与社区健康教育，尤其是运动现场急救方面，提供了新的视角。
items.titleZh: 接受培训，挽救生命：将大型体育赛事转变为心肺复苏培训平台
items.summaryZh: 这篇评论探讨了像 2020 年欧洲杯 Christian Eriksen 倒地这样的重大体育赛事如何成为推广心肺复苏 (CPR) 培训的平台，提倡从单纯的意识宣传转向整合的健康系统途径，使观众掌握实际的救生技能。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary uses the Christian Eriksen incident to highlight the potential of mega-sporting events as CPR training platforms, emphasizing the need to shift from awareness to practical skills training. This offers a new perspective for physical therapists to engage in community health education, particularly in sports emergency care.

items.title: Altitude challenges at the FIFA World Cup 2026: lessons to prepare and minimise the risks in future tournaments
items.summary: This commentary highlights the altitude challenges for the FIFA World Cup 2026, particularly the opening match in Mexico City (2240 m), discussing how reduced oxygen impairs athletic performance and decision-making in football, and calling for better preparation and risk minimization strategies for future tournaments.
items.curatedReason: 这篇评论讨论了 2026 年 FIFA 世界杯在海拔高度方面带来的挑战，回顾了高海拔对运动员表现和决策的影响，并提出了未来赛事的准备和风险最小化策略。这对运动康复专业人士来说，对于高海拔训练和比赛的风险管理提供了参考。
items.titleZh: 2026 年 FIFA 世界杯的海拔挑战：为未来赛事做准备并最小化风险的经验教训
items.summaryZh: 这篇评论强调了 2026 年 FIFA 世界杯的海拔挑战，特别是墨西哥城（海拔 2240 米）的开幕赛，讨论了氧气减少如何损害足球运动员的表现和决策能力，并呼吁为未来的比赛制定更好的准备和风险最小化策略。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary discusses the altitude challenges posed by the FIFA World Cup 2026, reviewing the impact of high altitude on athlete performance and decision-making, and outlining strategies for preparation and risk minimization in future tournaments. This offers a reference for sports rehabilitation professionals regarding risk management for high-altitude training and competition.

items.title: Effect of Music-Based Interventions in Cardiac Rehabilitation: A Systematic Review.
items.summary: A systematic review of nine studies on music-based interventions in cardiac rehabilitation found improvements in psychological outcomes, motivation, and exercise adherence, suggesting it as a supportive adjunct rather than a direct cardiovascular outcome modifier.
items.curatedReason: 该系统综述提示音乐干预可作为心肺康复的辅助手段，提升患者的心理健康、动机和依从性，而非直接改善心血管参数。这表明您可以在常规心肺康复方案中考虑引入音乐元素，以优化患者体验和依从性，但不要将其视为直接的心脏功能改善策略。
items.titleZh: 音乐干预对心脏康复影响的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对心脏康复中音乐干预的九项研究进行的系统综述发现，音乐干预改善了心理结局、动机和运动依从性，表明其是辅助手段而非直接的心血管结局改变剂。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review suggests music-based interventions can serve as an adjunct in cardiac rehabilitation, improving psychological well-being, motivation, and adherence rather than directly impacting cardiovascular parameters. This indicates you can consider incorporating music into standard CR protocols to enhance patient experience and adherence, but not as a direct strategy for cardiac function improvement.
items.limitation: 尽管是系统综述，但纳入研究的质量和样本量仍需提高，且缺乏客观的心血管结局测量。
items.limitationEn: Although a systematic review, the quality and sample size of included studies still need improvement, and objective cardiovascular outcome measures are lacking.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Artificial Intelligence in Extended Reality and Digital Rehabilitation Technologies for Fall Prevention in Older Adults: A Rapid Review of the Evidence.
items.summary: A rapid review of four studies on AI in extended reality and digital rehabilitation for fall prevention in older adults found XR/VR improved mobility and engagement, but evidence for AI's direct fall reduction benefits and specific contributions remains limited.
items.curatedReason: 快速综述确认了 XR/VR 在改善老年人移动性和依从性方面的潜力，但同时强调了 AI 在跌倒预防中直接益处的证据仍然有限。在临床实践中，可以考虑在有条件的设置下应用 XR/VR 改善移动性，但不必过度期待 AI 对跌倒事件本身的直接影响，仍需结合多因素干预。
items.titleZh: 人工智能在扩展现实和数字康复技术中用于老年人跌倒预防：证据快速综述
items.summaryZh: 一项针对人工智能在扩展现实 (XR) 和数字康复技术中用于老年人跌倒预防的四项研究快速综述发现，XR/VR 改善了移动性和参与度，但人工智能在直接减少跌倒方面的益处和具体贡献的证据仍有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: This rapid review confirms the potential of XR/VR in improving mobility and adherence in older adults, while also highlighting the limited direct evidence for AI's benefits in fall prevention. In clinical practice, you may consider using XR/VR for mobility enhancement where feasible, but do not overstate the direct impact of AI on fall incidents, and continue to integrate multifactorial interventions.
items.limitation: 纳入研究数量少（n=4），未直接测量跌倒发生率，且 AI-specific 证据不足。
items.limitationEn: Limited number of included studies (n=4), no direct measurement of fall incidence, and insufficient AI-specific evidence.

items.title: Predictors of response to spinal manipulative therapy, dry needling and exercise in patients with cervicogenic headache.
items.summary: A secondary analysis of 142 cervicogenic headache patients receiving spinal manipulative therapy, dry needling, and exercise found that male sex (OR: 3.906) and baseline headache intensity (OR: 1.708) were the strongest predictors of a successful outcome (≥50% improvement at 3 months).
items.curatedReason: 这项二级分析揭示了男性和基线头痛强度是颈源性头痛患者接受手法、干针和运动治疗后成功结局的显著预测因素。这提示您在评估和管理颈源性头痛患者时，可以更关注这些特征，并可能根据患者的基线疼痛水平和性别来调整治疗预期和沟通策略。
items.titleZh: 颈源性头痛患者对手法治疗、干针和运动反应的预测因素
items.summaryZh: 对 142 名接受脊柱手法治疗、干针和运动治疗的颈源性头痛患者的二级分析发现，男性（OR: 3.906）和基线头痛强度（OR: 1.708）是治疗成功（3 个月时改善≥50%）的最强预测因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This secondary analysis reveals that male sex and baseline headache intensity are significant predictors of successful outcomes in cervicogenic headache patients receiving manipulative therapy, dry needling, and exercise. This suggests that when assessing and managing cervicogenic headache patients, you can pay more attention to these characteristics, and potentially adjust treatment expectations and communication strategies based on the patient's baseline pain level and sex.
items.limitation: 本研究为多中心 RCT 的二级分析，但未探讨不同干预手段间的预测因子差异。
items.limitationEn: This is a secondary analysis of a multi-center RCT, but it did not explore differences in predictors among different intervention methods.

items.title: Availability in elite football: a practical framework for recording and communicating player health status
items.summary: This paper proposes a practical framework for recording and communicating elite football players' health status and availability to address the gap in traditional surveillance systems, which are primarily designed for research and do not consistently inform daily training and match planning.
items.curatedReason: 这篇文章提出了一个精英足球运动员健康状况记录和沟通的实用框架，旨在解决现有监测系统无法有效传达球员日常可用性的问题。这对于在运动领域工作的物理治疗师非常有价值，可以帮助您更高效地与教练和性能团队沟通，优化训练计划和比赛决策。
items.titleZh: 精英足球运动员的可用性：记录和沟通球员健康状况的实用框架
items.summaryZh: 本文提出了一个记录和沟通精英足球运动员健康状况和可用性的实用框架，旨在弥补传统监测系统（主要为研究设计）在日常训练和比赛计划中信息传达不一致的不足。
items.curatedReasonEn: If you work in elite football, this framework is tailored for you. It addresses the shortcomings of traditional surveillance systems in communicating player daily availability, helping you more effectively communicate player health status with coaching and performance staff, thereby optimizing training plans and match lineup decisions, making your work more efficient.

items.title: Specialised Acquired Brain Injury Community Outreach Provision - a Service Evaluation Cohort to Enable Practice Development and Improvement.
items.summary: A six-year service evaluation (2019-2025) of a UK regional specialized community outreach provision for acquired brain injury found that activity doubled, with primary referrals for spasticity and complex physical management, highlighting the expanding utilization and need for service delivery partnerships.
items.curatedReason: 这项服务评估展示了区域性专业社区外展服务在支持复杂性脑损伤患者（特别是痉挛管理）方面的扩展利用。这提示您在面对复杂神经康复需求时，可以考虑与这类专业服务建立更紧密的合作模式，以提供更无缝的护理。
items.titleZh: 专业脑损伤社区外展服务：一项旨在促进实践发展和改进的服务评估队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对英国区域性专业脑损伤社区外展服务为期六年的评估（2019-2025）发现，服务活动量翻倍，主要转诊原因涉及痉挛和复杂身体管理，强调了其利用率的增长以及服务合作的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This service evaluation demonstrates the expanding utilization of regional specialized community outreach for complex brain injury patients, especially in spasticity management. This suggests that you might consider closer collaboration with such specialized services when addressing complex neurorehabilitation needs, to provide more seamless care.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性服务评估，缺乏对照组且数据仅来自单一区域服务。
items.limitationEn: This study is a retrospective service evaluation, lacking a control group and with data from a single regional service.

items.title: Structured exercise interventions and survival outcomes in patients with cancer: systematic review and meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 21 RCTs (n=3828 for overall survival) found that structured exercise interventions were associated with significant improvements in overall survival (HR 0.77; 95% CI 0.65 to 0.92), disease-free survival (HR 0.83; 95% CI 0.72 to 0.95), reduced all-cause mortality (RR 0.82), and reduced cancer-specific mortality (RR 0.74) in patients with cancer, with moderate certainty of evidence.
items.curatedReason: 结构化运动干预不仅能改善癌症患者的生活质量和身体功能，还能显著延长总生存期（HR 0.77）和无病生存期（HR 0.83）。这为肿瘤康复中的运动处方提供了坚实的证据，应将其视为癌症治疗的辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 结构化运动干预与癌症患者生存结局：随机对照试验的系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 这项对 21 项随机对照试验（总生存期 n=3828）的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，结构化运动干预与癌症患者的总生存期（HR 0.77；95% CI 0.65 至 0.92）、无病生存期（HR 0.83；95% CI 0.72 至 0.95）、全因死亡率降低（RR 0.82）和癌症特异性死亡率降低（RR 0.74）显著相关，证据确定性为中等。
items.curatedReasonEn: Structured exercise interventions not only improve quality of life and physical function in cancer patients but also significantly prolong overall survival (HR 0.77) and disease-free survival (HR 0.83). This provides strong evidence for exercise prescription in oncology rehabilitation and should be considered an adjuvant therapy in cancer care.
items.limitation: 纳入 RCT 的证据确定性为中等，且存在样本量和异质性问题。
items.limitationEn: The certainty of evidence for the included RCTs is moderate, and there are issues with sample size and heterogeneity.

items.title: The effect of multimodal sensory therapy in consciousness improvement in patients with acquired brain injury: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 18 studies (884 participants) found that multimodal sensory therapy (MST) significantly improved consciousness levels (SMD, 1.48; 95% CI, 1.04-1.92) and increased the odds of coma emergence (OR, 9.85; 95% CI, 3.86-25.01) in adults with acquired brain injury-related disorders of consciousness.
items.curatedReason: 多模式感觉疗法对脑损伤患者意识障碍有效，能显著改善意识水平（SMD 1.48）并提高昏迷苏醒几率（OR 9.85）。但证据异质性高，还需标准化方案和评估工具。
items.titleZh: 多模式感觉疗法在获得性脑损伤患者意识改善中的作用：系统综述与 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述和 Meta 分析纳入 18 项研究（884 名受试者），发现多模式感觉疗法（MST）可显著改善获得性脑损伤相关意识障碍患者的意识水平（SMD 1.48）并提高昏迷苏醒几率（OR 9.85）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Multimodal sensory therapy is effective for disorders of consciousness in acquired brain injury patients, significantly improving consciousness levels (SMD 1.48) and increasing coma emergence odds (OR 9.85). However, evidence heterogeneity is high, requiring standardized protocols and assessment tools.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学局限性和结果异质性较高，可能影响证据的确定性。
items.limitationEn: High methodological limitations and heterogeneity across included studies may impact the certainty of evidence.

items.title: Do blood flow restriction exercises offer additional benefits when compared to conventional exercises in musculoskeletal rehabilitation? A systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 45 RCTs (1652 participants) found low-certainty evidence that low-load exercise with blood flow restriction (LLE-BFR) was superior to low-load exercise (LLE) for muscle strength (SMD=0.82) and disability (SMD=0.63). Moderate-certainty evidence showed no clear difference between LLE-BFR and high-load exercise (HLE) for muscle strength (SMD=0.08).
items.curatedReason: 对肌肉骨骼康复而言，低负荷血流限制训练（LLE-BFR）在改善肌力和功能障碍方面优于低负荷训练（LLE），且与高负荷训练（HLE）效果相当。将 LLE-BFR 纳入临床实践，可为无法承受高负荷的患者提供有效选择。
items.titleZh: 与肌肉骨骼康复中的常规运动相比，血流限制运动是否提供额外益处？一项系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 这项对 45 项随机对照试验（1652 名受试者）的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，低确定性证据表明低负荷血流限制运动（LLE-BFR）在肌力（SMD=0.82）和功能障碍（SMD=0.63）方面优于低负荷运动（LLE）。中等确定性证据显示，LLE-BFR 与高负荷运动（HLE）在肌力方面无明显差异（SMD=0.08）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For musculoskeletal rehabilitation, low-load exercise with blood flow restriction (LLE-BFR) is superior to low-load exercise (LLE) in improving muscle strength and disability, and comparable to high-load exercise (HLE). Incorporating LLE-BFR into clinical practice offers an effective option for patients unable to tolerate high loads.
items.limitation: 大部分纳入研究的偏倚风险为“存在一些担忧”，且证据确定性从低到极低，这限制了结论的稳健性。
items.limitationEn: Most included trials had 'some concerns' for risk of bias, and evidence certainty ranged from low to very low, limiting the robustness of conclusions.

items.title: Removing barriers to physical activity for people with long-term conditions: co-creating patient-centred guidance through a multistakeholder consensus approach
items.summary: This study developed patient-centered, consensus-based digital guidance that offers an alternative to routine medical clearance for people with long-term conditions engaging in organized physical activity. It aims to remove existing barriers by supporting informed, autonomous decision-making through four headline safety statements and seven symptom-specific statements.
items.curatedReason: 为慢性病患者提供运动指导时，不应再常规要求医疗许可。这项研究共创的患者中心化指南能帮助患者自主决策，降低参与运动的门槛，值得在临床实践中推广。
items.titleZh: 消除慢性病患者参与身体活动的障碍：通过多方利益相关者共识方法共同制定以患者为中心的指南
items.summaryZh: 本研究通过多方利益相关者共识方法，制定了以患者为中心的数字化指南，旨在替代慢性病患者参与有组织身体活动的常规医疗许可。该指南包含四项主要安全声明和七项针对症状的声明，旨在通过支持知情、自主决策来消除现有障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: Medical clearance should no longer be routinely required for patients with long-term conditions when providing exercise guidance. This co-created patient-centered guidance empowers patients to make autonomous decisions, reducing barriers to physical activity, and is worth promoting in clinical practice.

items.title: REmotely monitored, Mobile health-supported Multidomain Rehabilitation with High Intensity Interval Training for COVID-19 (REMM-HIIT-CoV): Trial Design and Rationale.
items.summary: This article outlines the design and rationale for REMM-HIIT-CoV, a multicenter, single-blinded RCT evaluating a remotely monitored, mobile health-supported multidomain rehabilitation program with high-intensity interval training for functional exercise capacity in 140 community-dwelling adults post-COVID-19 hospitalization.
items.curatedReason: 对于 COVID-19 康复患者，目前缺少高质量的居家康复方案。这项针对 140 名社区成年人的多中心 RCT，如果结果积极，将明确远程监控结合 HIIT 的多领域康复对改善功能锻炼能力的作用。
items.titleZh: COVID-19 远程监测、移动健康支持的多领域康复结合高强度间歇训练（REMM-HIIT-CoV）：试验设计与原理
items.summaryZh: 本文概述了 REMM-HIIT-CoV 试验的设计与原理，这是一项多中心、单盲随机对照试验，旨在评估远程监测、移动健康支持的多领域康复结合高强度间歇训练对 140 名 COVID-19 住院后社区居民的功能性运动能力的干预效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: High-quality home-based rehabilitation for post-COVID-19 patients is still lacking. If positive, this multicenter RCT in 140 community-dwelling adults will establish whether remotely monitored, multidomain rehab with HIIT can improve functional exercise capacity.
items.limitation: 本研究为试验设计与原理，尚未发布实际结果。
items.limitationEn: This study describes trial design and rationale; actual results are not yet published.

items.title: From evidence to action: a global call to advance sleep health in sport
items.summary: This editorial highlights the growing awareness of sleep health in sport but notes that many high-performance environments still operate contrary to healthy sleep and circadian biology, calling for a global, coordinated effort to implement evidence-based sleep health practices.
items.curatedReason: 运动领域对睡眠健康的认知度显著提高，但高绩效环境中的实践仍与健康睡眠和昼夜节律不符。应利用证据制定更实际的睡眠健康策略，这对于运动员的康复和表现至关重要。
items.titleZh: 从证据到行动：促进运动睡眠健康的全球倡议
items.summaryZh: 这篇社论指出，体育界对睡眠健康的认识显著提高，但许多高绩效环境的运作方式仍与健康睡眠和昼夜节律生物学相悖，呼吁全球协同努力，实施循证睡眠健康实践。
items.curatedReasonEn: While awareness of sleep health in sports has significantly increased, high-performance environments still operate in ways misaligned with healthy sleep and circadian biology. Evidence should be leveraged to develop more practical sleep health strategies, which are crucial for athlete recovery and performance.

items.title: Training-related concussions in mens English Premiership Rugby Union: an eight-season prospective cohort study of 153 243 player-weeks
items.summary: An eight-season prospective cohort study (153,243 player-weeks) in elite men's English Premiership Rugby Union found a training-related concussion incidence of 0.23 per 1000 hours, with preseason (IRR 1.80) and full-contact training (IRR 2.20) significantly increasing risk compared to the final three months of the season and non-contact training.
items.curatedReason: 英式橄榄球中，季前赛和全面接触训练与训练相关脑震荡风险增加密切相关。在设计训练计划时，应战略性规划这些高风险时段，以最大程度地降低运动员受伤风险。
items.titleZh: 英式橄榄球超级联赛男子训练相关脑震荡：一项为期八个赛季的 153,243 运动员周前瞻性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对英式橄榄球超级联赛男子精英运动员进行的为期八个赛季（153,243 运动员周）的前瞻性队列研究发现，训练相关脑震荡发生率为每 1000 小时 0.23 例。与赛季末三个月和非接触训练相比，季前赛（IRR 1.80）和全面接触训练（IRR 2.20）显著增加了脑震荡风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: In English Premiership Rugby Union, preseason and full-contact training are closely associated with an increased risk of training-related concussions. These high-risk periods should be strategically planned when designing training programs to minimize athlete injury risk.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅限于精英男子橄榄球运动员，结果可能不完全适用于其他运动或人群。
items.limitationEn: The study is limited to elite male rugby players, and results may not be fully generalizable to other sports or populations.

items.title: Combinations of stepping intensity and daily step counts against all-cause and cardiovascular disease mortality: insights from a device-based prospective study
items.summary: A prospective cohort study (64,743 UK Biobank participants) found that combinations of stepping intensity (peak 30-min cadence) and daily step counts (<5000, 5000-7500, 7500-10,000, >10,000 steps/day) were associated with different risks for all-cause and cardiovascular disease mortality, with 7500-10,000 steps/day at approximately 100 steps/min showing the lowest all-cause mortality risk (HR 0.57; 95% CI 0.47 to 0.69).
items.curatedReason: 步数强度和每日步数对全因及心血管疾病死亡率的影响存在多种组合。建议患者不要只关注步数总量，同时考虑步速和中高强度步行的重要性。
items.titleZh: 步数强度与每日步数组合对全因和心血管疾病死亡率的影响：一项基于设备的前瞻性研究的见解
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性队列研究（64,743 名英国生物样本库参与者）发现，步数强度（峰值 30 分钟步频）和每日步数（<5000、5000-7500、7500-10,000、>10,000 步/天）的组合与全因及心血管疾病死亡率的不同风险相关，其中 7500-10,000 步/天且步频约 100 步/分钟的全因死亡率风险最低（HR 0.57；95% CI 0.47 至 0.69）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Various combinations of stepping intensity and daily step counts influence all-cause and cardiovascular disease mortality. Advise patients not to focus solely on total steps, but also to consider the importance of stepping cadence and moderate-to-vigorous intensity walking.
items.limitation: 研究使用腕戴式加速计数据，可能存在测量误差，且人群以英国生物样本库参与者为主，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study used wrist-worn accelerometer data, which may have measurement errors, and the population primarily consists of UK Biobank participants, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Multidimensional evidence map of sport science and medicine research in highly trained, elite and world-class female athletes: a scoping review
items.summary: A scoping review of 3,867 records (1970-2025) on sport science and medicine research in highly trained female athletes found increasing but persistent gaps in participant representation (31% female), geographical coverage, and health-related themes, with pelvic floor (26 studies), breast health (11 studies), and (peri-)menopause (2 studies) being least common.
items.curatedReason: 尽管高水平女性运动员的研究在增加，但在参与者代表性、地理覆盖和健康相关主题（如盆底、乳房健康、围绝经期）方面仍存在显著空白。作为临床医生，应更关注这些被忽视的领域，推动以女性为中心的康复研究和实践。
items.titleZh: 高水平、精英和世界级女性运动员运动科学与医学研究的多维证据图谱：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 3,867 份（1970-2025 年）关于高水平女性运动员运动科学与医学研究的范围综述发现，尽管研究在增加，但在参与者代表性（31% 女性）、地理覆盖和健康相关主题方面仍存在持续的空白，其中盆底（26 项研究）、乳房健康（11 项研究）和（围）绝经期（2 项研究）是最不常见的。
items.curatedReasonEn: Although research on high-level female athletes is increasing, significant gaps remain in participant representation, geographical coverage, and health-related themes (e.g., pelvic floor, breast health, perimenopause). As clinicians, we should focus more on these underserved areas to advance female-centered rehabilitation research and practice.
items.limitation: 此为范围综述，不提供干预效果的量化证据，主要揭示研究现状和空白。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review that provides an overview of the research landscape and gaps, not quantitative evidence of intervention effects.

items.title: The load-velocity profile as a muscle quality index and fall risk predictor in older adults: a multifactorial perspective (PhD Academy Award).
items.summary: This PhD Academy Award report explores the load-velocity profile as a potential muscle quality index and fall risk predictor in older adults, offering a multifactorial perspective on its clinical utility.
items.curatedReason: 负荷-速度曲线有望成为评估老年人肌肉质量和预测跌倒风险的指标，为制定个性化康复方案提供更多信息。
items.titleZh: 负荷-速度曲线作为老年人肌肉质量指标和跌倒风险预测因子：多因素视角（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 这项博士学院奖报告探讨了负荷-速度曲线作为老年人肌肉质量指标和跌倒风险预测因子的潜力，并从多因素视角分析其临床应用。
items.curatedReasonEn: The load-velocity profile could serve as an index for assessing muscle quality and predicting fall risk in older adults, offering additional information for personalized rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 本研究为博士奖项报告，完整方法学细节和结果需参考后续发表的论文。
items.limitationEn: This is a PhD Academy Award report; full methodological details and results will be available in the subsequent published paper.

items.title: Five years on, NO PROGRESS: the gender equity crisis in sport and exercise medicine publishing persists - action is now overdue
items.summary: A review of the top 50 SCImago-ranked journals for sport medicine and physical therapy reveals that gender inequity in publishing has not improved over the past five years, with women representing only 33% of first authors in 2024, mirroring previous findings from 2008/2009 and 2018/2019.
items.curatedReason: 运动与运动医学出版领域的性别不平等问题持续存在且未改善，女性作者比例仍仅为 33%。PT 领域同样面临此挑战，应关注并促进公平。
items.titleZh: 五年过去，毫无进展：运动与运动医学出版领域的性别平等危机持续存在——行动刻不容缓
items.summaryZh: 对排名前 50 的运动医学和物理治疗期刊的审查显示，出版领域的性别不平等在过去五年中并未改善，2024 年女性第一作者的比例仍为 33%，与 2008/2009 年和 2018/2019 年的研究结果相似。
items.curatedReasonEn: Gender inequity persists and shows no improvement in sport and exercise medicine publishing, with women authors still at only 33%. The PT field faces similar challenges and should actively promote equity.

items.title: Associations of physical, psychosocial and dual-career loads with injury and illness occurrence among elite handball players (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: This PhD Academy Award report outlines a thesis investigating how physical, psychosocial, and dual-career loads contribute to injuries and illnesses in elite handball players, adopting a biopsychosocial perspective to move beyond traditional physical injury etiology models.
items.curatedReason: 精英手球运动员的伤病发生不仅与生理负荷有关，还与心理社会和双重职业负荷密切相关。在制定康复和预防策略时，应整合生物心理社会视角，全面评估运动员的多种负荷。
items.titleZh: 精英手球运动员的生理、心理社会和双重职业负荷与伤病发生关联（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 这项博士学院奖报告概述了一项博士论文，旨在调查生理、心理社会和双重职业负荷如何影响精英手球运动员的伤病发生，并采用生物心理社会视角，超越传统的生理伤病病因模型。
items.curatedReasonEn: Injuries in elite handball players are not only linked to physical load but also closely associated with psychosocial and dual-career loads. When developing rehabilitation and prevention strategies, a biopsychosocial perspective should be integrated to comprehensively assess athletes' multiple loads.
items.limitation: 本研究为博士奖项报告，完整方法学细节和结果需参考后续发表的论文。
items.limitationEn: This is a PhD Academy Award report; full methodological details and results will be available in the subsequent published paper.

items.title: Muscle injuries in football: integrating structural and neuromuscular outcomes to minimise reinjury risk and enhance post-injury performance (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: This PhD Academy Award report outlines a thesis integrating seven studies across three phases—exploratory analyses, muscle structure, and neuromuscular function/performance outcomes—to minimize reinjury risk and enhance post-injury performance after muscle injuries in football players, also validating a portable ultrasound device.
items.curatedReason: 足球运动员肌肉损伤后的康复策略应整合结构和神经肌肉功能评估，以降低再损伤风险并提升赛后表现。临床医生在制定重返赛场（RTP）标准时，要关注大腿肌肉形态和力-速度曲线的变化。
items.titleZh: 足球运动员肌肉损伤：整合结构和神经肌肉功能结果以最小化再损伤风险并提高伤后表现（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 这项博士学院奖报告概述了一项博士论文，通过探索性分析、肌肉结构和神经肌肉功能/表现结果三个阶段的七项研究，旨在最小化足球运动员肌肉损伤后的再损伤风险并提高伤后表现，同时验证了一种便携式超声设备。
items.curatedReasonEn: Rehabilitation strategies for muscle injuries in football players should integrate structural and neuromuscular function assessments to minimize reinjury risk and enhance post-injury performance. Clinicians setting Return to Play (RTP) criteria should focus on changes in thigh muscle morphology and force-velocity profiles.
items.limitation: 本研究为博士奖项报告，完整方法学细节和结果需参考后续发表的论文。
items.limitationEn: This is a PhD Academy Award report; full methodological details and results will be available in the subsequent published paper.

items.title: Turf toe: an occupational hazard in football players
items.summary: This case report describes a 23-year-old collegiate male football player presenting with acute right great toe pain and hyperextension injury after playing on natural turf, diagnosed with a high-grade plantar plate ('turf toe') injury involving complete rupture of the medial and lateral sesamophalangeal ligaments.
items.curatedReason: “人工草坪趾”（Turf toe）是足球运动员常见的足部损伤。作为物理治疗师，在评估足部疼痛时应警惕这种高等级跖趾关节损伤，尤其是当患者在人工草坪上运动后出现持续疼痛和功能受限时。
items.titleZh: 人工草坪趾：足球运动员的职业危害
items.summaryZh: 本病例报告描述了一名 23 岁大学橄榄球男运动员在天然草坪上比赛后出现急性右脚大脚趾疼痛和过伸损伤，诊断为高等级跖趾关节（“人工草坪趾”）损伤，涉及内侧和外侧籽骨趾骨韧带完全断裂。
items.curatedReasonEn: Turf toe is a common foot injury in football players. As physical therapists, be vigilant for this high-grade MTPJ injury when evaluating foot pain, especially if patients experience persistent pain and functional limitations after playing on artificial turf.
items.limitation: 本研究为病例报告，其结果不具备普适性，仅提供个案参考价值。
items.limitationEn: This is a case report, so its findings are not generalizable and only offer insights from a single case.

items.title: Optimal exercise dose in adults with chronic low back pain disorders: systematic review with dose-response network meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and network meta-analysis of 239 trials found that low to moderate exercise doses were associated with short-term, potentially clinically meaningful improvements in disability and pain intensity for chronic low back pain, with optimal model-predicted doses of 4 sessions/week, 25 min/session over 13 weeks for disability, and 3 sessions/week, 30 min/session over 8 weeks for pain.
items.curatedReason: 这项纳入 239 项试验的系统综述指出了慢性下腰痛的运动剂量建议，但强调证据确定性极低。对短期残疾和疼痛，它给出了模型预测的最佳剂量，但别过分解读，继续将运动疗法作为一线，但保持个性化。
items.titleZh: 慢性下腰痛患者的最佳运动剂量：系统综述与剂量反应网络荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 239 项试验的系统综述与网络荟萃分析发现，中低强度运动剂量与慢性下腰痛患者短期残疾和疼痛强度的临床有意义改善相关；模型预测的最佳剂量为短期残疾 4 次/周、25 分钟/次，持续 13 周，短期疼痛 3 次/周、30 分钟/次，持续 8 周。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review of 239 trials provides exercise dose recommendations for chronic low back pain, but emphasizes very low certainty of evidence. While it offers model-predicted optimal doses for short-term disability and pain, avoid over-interpreting these. Continue to prioritize exercise therapy as a first-line intervention, but maintain a personalized approach.
items.limitation: 绝大多数纳入研究存在高偏倚风险，且证据确定性极低，模型预测的剂量建议需谨慎解读。
items.limitationEn: The vast majority of included studies had a high risk of bias, and the certainty of evidence was very low to low, necessitating cautious interpretation of model-predicted dose recommendations.

items.title: Exercise-only interventions and exercise-based multidomain lifestyle interventions to promote cognitive function in older adults without dementia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 227 studies found that exercise-only interventions significantly improved executive functions, memory, and processing speed in older adults without dementia compared to control. Exercise-plus interventions (exercise combined with other lifestyle interventions) were significantly better than exercise-only for executive functions and processing speed, but not for memory.
items.curatedReason: 对于没有痴呆的老年人，运动是改善认知功能（执行功能、记忆、处理速度）的基石。如果你想在执行功能和处理速度上获得更佳效果，应考虑结合其他生活方式干预。但对于记忆，运动本身已足够有效。
items.titleZh: 单独运动干预和基于运动的多领域生活方式干预对无痴呆老年人认知功能的促进作用：系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 227 项研究的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，对于无痴呆老年人，单独运动干预相比对照组能显著改善执行功能、记忆和处理速度。运动结合其他生活方式干预（Exercise-Plus）在改善执行功能和处理速度方面优于单独运动，但在记忆方面无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For older adults without dementia, exercise is a cornerstone for improving cognitive function (executive functions, memory, processing speed). If you aim for superior outcomes in executive functions and processing speed, consider combining exercise with other lifestyle interventions. However, for memory, exercise alone is sufficiently effective.
items.limitation: 仍需进一步研究以确定多领域运动干预相比单纯运动所带来的额外益处。
items.limitationEn: Further research is needed to determine the added benefit of multidomain exercise interventions compared to exercise-only approaches.

items.title: Combining three-dimensional ankle exercises with short-foot training improves proprioception and dynamic balance in female karatekas with flatfoot: A randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=34) found that combining three-dimensional ankle exercises with short-foot training (SF-3DAE) led to greater improvements in navicular drop (2.24 mm vs 1.16 mm), ankle proprioception (3° vs 1.59° error), and dynamic balance (17.49% vs 7.82% Y-Balance total reach) compared to short-foot exercise (SFE) alone in female karate athletes with flatfoot.
items.curatedReason: 对于扁平足空手道运动员，这项 RCT 表明三维踝关节训练与短足训练结合，在改善足部姿态、本体感觉和动态平衡方面优于单独的短足训练。这提示你可以考虑将多平面踝关节训练纳入此类运动员的足部康复方案。
items.titleZh: 三维踝关节训练结合短足训练可改善扁平足女性空手道运动员的本体感觉和动态平衡：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=34）发现，扁平足女性空手道运动员采用三维踝关节训练结合短足训练（SF-3DAE）在足舟骨下沉、踝关节本体感觉和动态平衡方面，优于单独短足训练（SFE）；SF-3DAE 组足舟骨下沉减少 2.24 毫米，本体感觉误差减少 3°，Y-Balance 总触及增加 17.49 个百分点，均显著优于 SFE 组。
items.curatedReasonEn: For flatfoot karate athletes, this RCT suggests that combining three-dimensional ankle exercises with short-foot training is superior to short-foot training alone for improving foot posture, proprioception, and dynamic balance. This indicates you might consider incorporating multi-planar ankle training into foot rehabilitation programs for such athletes.
items.limitation: 由于联合训练组的训练量更大，无法完全排除训练量增加带来的影响；且研究未评估这些改善是否能转化为运动表现提升或受伤风险降低。
items.limitationEn: The increased training volume in the combined exercise group means the contribution of training volume effect cannot be fully separated, and the study did not assess whether these improvements translate into enhanced athletic performance or reduced injury risk.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Opioid use following spinal cord injury: a qualitative study of the perspectives of healthcare providers and people with lived experience.
items.summary: A qualitative study based on interviews with 14 healthcare providers and 9 people with spinal cord injury (SCI) in Australia found that opioid use is normalized in acute care post-SCI, creating an overreliance that extends into rehabilitation and community settings due to limited follow-up and access to non-pharmacological pain supports.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了脊髓损伤患者术后阿片类药物使用在住院和社区护理中的常态化问题，以及澳大利亚医疗系统在综合疼痛管理方面的挑战。它提示你应该在患者教育和跨学科协作方面发挥作用，以减少阿片类药物依赖，并倡导更好的非药物疼痛管理支持。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤后阿片类药物使用：医疗服务提供者和有亲身经验者的视角定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 14 名医疗服务提供者和 9 名脊髓损伤（SCI）患者进行的定性研究发现，SCI 后急性期阿片类药物使用常态化，导致在康复和社区环境中过度依赖，这主要归因于随访不足和非药物疼痛支持的可及性有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights the normalization of opioid use in both inpatient and community settings after spinal cord injury, and challenges within the Australian healthcare system for comprehensive pain management. It suggests you have a role in patient education and interdisciplinary collaboration to reduce opioid reliance and advocate for better non-pharmacological pain management support.

items.title: Item-level analysis and network analysis of the functional independence measure cognitive items at discharge after acute stroke.
items.summary: A retrospective item-level and network analysis of FIM cognitive items in 974 acute stroke patients at discharge found clinically interpretable heterogeneity in item-level profiles, with two major conditional associations: comprehension-expression (r=0.71) and memory-problem solving (r=0.55).
items.curatedReason: FIM 认知项目在卒中患者出院时的表现并非均质，理解-表达（r=0.71）和记忆-解决问题（r=0.55）之间存在强关联。这提示我们，评估时应将这两个组块视为功能簇，有助于更精准地识别认知障碍模式，而非将所有 FIM 认知项目一概而论。
items.titleZh: 急性卒中患者出院时功能独立性评定认知项目的条目水平和网络分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 974 名急性卒中患者出院时 FIM 认知项目的回顾性条目水平和网络分析发现，项目水平存在临床可解释的异质性，并揭示了两个主要的条件关联：“理解-表达”（r=0.71）和“记忆-问题解决”（r=0.55）。
items.curatedReasonEn: FIM cognitive items at stroke discharge are not homogeneous; strong associations exist between comprehension-expression (r=0.71) and memory-problem solving (r=0.55). This suggests we should view these as functional clusters during assessment, allowing for more precise identification of cognitive impairment patterns, rather than treating all FIM cognitive items uniformly.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性研究，且未验证这些发现与外部临床结局之间的纵向关系。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective study and did not longitudinally validate these findings against external clinical outcomes.

items.title: Stroke survivors' experience using mechanically-assisted devices as a component of their upper limb motor rehabilitation program.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 11 stroke survivors using mechanically-assisted upper limb devices for rehabilitation identified five major themes: mastery of practice, benefits of the device, drawbacks of practice (e.g., setup complexity, discomfort), the influence of people, and suggestions for enhancement, emphasizing the importance of clinician involvement.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了卒中患者在使用机械辅助上肢康复设备时的体验。它提示你，在引进和使用这类设备时，要重视患者的内在动机、提供目标导向的反馈，并且确保有效的临床支持与沟通，这对于设备在临床中的有效集成至关重要。
items.titleZh: 卒中幸存者使用机械辅助设备作为上肢运动康复项目组成部分的体验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 11 名使用机械辅助设备进行上肢康复的卒中幸存者的定性研究发现，其体验主要围绕五个主题：自主训练、设备优势、设备缺点（如设置复杂、身体不适）、人员影响以及改进建议，强调了临床医生参与的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights stroke survivors' experiences with mechanically-assisted upper limb rehabilitation devices. It suggests that when integrating and using such devices, you should prioritize patient intrinsic motivation, provide goal-oriented feedback, and ensure effective clinical support and communication, which are crucial for successful clinical implementation.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（n=11），且仅限于卒中后 6 个月内的患者，结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (n=11) and was limited to stroke survivors within 6 months post-stroke, limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: 2027 ICD-10 Coding Changes Go Into Effect October 1. Here's What Could Impact Rehab Therapists
items.summary: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) is implementing its annual updates to ICD-10 coding, which will go into effect on October 1, 2026. These changes impact how rehab therapists will code for diagnoses and procedures, affecting reimbursement and compliance.
items.curatedReason: 美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）的 ICD-10 编码每年都在更新，影响着你在诊断和报销时的准确性。立即了解这些即将生效的年度变化，确保你的账单合规，避免申诉和收入损失。
items.titleZh: 2027年ICD-10编码变更将于10月1日生效，康复治疗师可能受到的影响
items.summaryZh: 美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）即将实施年度ICD-10编码更新，将于2026年10月1日生效。这些变化将影响康复治疗师诊断和操作的编码方式，从而影响报销和合规性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The annual updates to ICD-10 coding by CMS affect the accuracy of your diagnoses and reimbursements. Immediately familiarize yourself with these upcoming annual changes to ensure billing compliance and avoid claims denials and revenue loss.

items.title: Perceptions and Experiences of Returning to Sport Following Myocardial Infarction: A Qualitative Study.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored perceptions of returning to sport post-myocardial infarction, identifying four themes: reconciling active identity with new reality, feeling vulnerable, the need for strong support, and navigating one's own path. Psychosocial challenges, fear, and uncertainty were prominent, highlighting the need for tailored advice and support.
items.curatedReason: 心脏病发作后重返运动需要你更关注患者的心理社会层面需求，包括他们身份认同的调和、脆弱感，以及对量身定制支持的渴望。别只停留在生理风险评估，还要帮助他们管理恐惧、不确定性，并提供相关信息与支持。
items.titleZh: 心肌梗死后重返运动的感知与体验：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了心肌梗死后重返运动的感知，归纳出四个主题：调和活跃身份与新现实、感到脆弱、需要强有力支持、以及自主探索道路。心理社会挑战、恐惧和不确定性突出，强调了提供量身定制建议和支持的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Returning to sport after myocardial infarction requires you to focus more on patients' psychosocial needs, including identity reconciliation, vulnerability, and the desire for tailored support. Don't just stop at physiological risk assessment; help them manage fear and uncertainty, and provide relevant information and support.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小，结果的普遍性和推论性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size, limiting the generalizability and inferential power of its findings.

items.title: Beliefs and Practices of Pediatric Physiotherapists in Türkiye Regarding Early Mobility and Crawling.
items.summary: An online survey of 109 pediatric physiotherapists in Türkiye found that 94.5% believed crawling was important and 63% opposed its removal from CDC developmental checklists. These beliefs influenced therapeutic approaches, with many training hands-and-knees crawling when clinically appropriate.
items.curatedReason: 尽管CDC已从发育里程碑中移除爬行，但土耳其的儿科物理治疗师普遍仍认为爬行重要且与多种正面发育结果相关，并会在临床中训练爬行。这反映了临床信念与指南更新之间可能存在的张力，提醒你要审视自己的观念，并结合最新证据。
items.titleZh: 土耳其儿科物理治疗师关于早期移动和爬行的信念与实践
items.summaryZh: 一项对土耳其109名儿科物理治疗师的在线调查显示，94.5%的治疗师认为爬行很重要，63%反对将其从CDC发育里程碑清单中移除。这些信念影响了治疗方法，许多治疗师会在临床适当时训练手膝爬行。
items.curatedReasonEn: Despite CDC's removal of crawling from developmental milestones, pediatric physical therapists in Türkiye widely believe crawling is important and linked to positive developmental outcomes, often incorporating it into practice. This highlights potential tension between clinical beliefs and guideline updates, urging you to review your own views and integrate the latest evidence.
items.limitation: 本研究为在线调查，可能存在报告偏倚和样本选择偏倚，且研究对象仅限于土耳其的儿科物理治疗师，结果不一定能推广至其他地区。
items.limitationEn: This online survey may suffer from reporting and selection bias, and its findings, restricted to pediatric physical therapists in Türkiye, may not be generalizable to other regions.

items.title: Fatigue-related neuromuscular outcomes following ACL reconstruction: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 17 studies (n=477) found that individuals post-ACL reconstruction showed greater post-fatigue impairments in quadriceps central activation ratio (SMD: -0.69, p < 0.001) and muscle activation patterns (SMD: -0.62, p < 0.001) compared to healthy controls, with moderate-certainty evidence.
items.curatedReason: ACL重建术后患者在疲劳状态下，股四头肌的中央激活率（SMD: -0.69）和肌肉激活模式（SMD: -0.62）确实受损更严重。在重返运动前，你必须将疲劳作为关键考量因素，评估并训练其神经肌肉控制能力，以最大程度地降低再损伤的风险。
items.titleZh: ACL重建术后疲劳相关的神经肌肉结果：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含17项研究（n=477）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，与健康对照组相比，ACL重建术后个体在疲劳后股四头肌的中央激活率（SMD: -0.69, p < 0.001）和肌肉激活模式（SMD: -0.62, p < 0.001）方面表现出更大的损伤，证据确定性为中等。
items.curatedReasonEn: Post-ACL reconstruction, patients indeed exhibit greater fatigue-related impairments in quadriceps central activation ratio (SMD: -0.69) and muscle activation patterns (SMD: -0.62). Before return-to-sport, you must prioritize fatigue as a critical factor, assessing and training neuromuscular control to minimize the risk of re-injury.
items.limitation: 部分结果（如峰力矩和时间稳定性）因异质性或研究数量限制，证据确定性较低，需谨慎解读。
items.limitationEn: Some outcomes (e.g., peak torque and time to stability) have low certainty of evidence due to heterogeneity or limited studies, requiring cautious interpretation.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Single-bundle versus double-bundle reconstruction in anterior cruciate ligament: a meta-analysis
items.summary: A meta-analysis of 41 RCTs (n=3568) found no significant difference in short/long-term KT-1000/2000 side-to-side differences between single-bundle (SB) and double-bundle (DB) ACL reconstruction. DB showed significantly higher negative pivot-shift test rates (OR=0.62, p<0.001 short-term; OR=0.37, p=0.007 long-term) and higher long-term Lysholm scores (MD=-1.32, p=0.004).
items.curatedReason: 这项荟萃分析发现，ACL重建术中单束与双束重建在短期和长期KT-1000/2000关节镜侧向差异上无显著差异，但双束重建在枢轴移位试验阴性率和长期Lysholm评分上有优势。这意味着单束重建仍是可靠选项，但双束在旋转稳定性和长期功能上可能更优。你需要根据患者的年龄、活动需求和你的手术经验来个体化选择术式，并知情告知患者。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建中单束与双束重建的荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含41项随机对照试验（n=3568）的荟萃分析发现，单束（SB）与双束（DB）ACL重建在短期/长期KT-1000/2000关节镜侧向差异上无显著差异。DB组的枢轴移位试验阴性率（短期OR=0.62, p<0.001; 长期OR=0.37, p=0.007）和长期Lysholm评分（MD=-1.32, p=0.004）均显著更高。
items.curatedReasonEn: This meta-analysis found no significant difference between single-bundle (SB) and double-bundle (DB) ACL reconstruction in short- and long-term KT-1000/2000 arthrometer side-to-side differences, but DB reconstruction showed advantages in negative pivot-shift test rates and long-term Lysholm scores. This means SB reconstruction remains a reliable option, but DB might be superior in rotational stability and long-term function. You need to individualize surgical technique based on patient age, activity demands, and your surgical expertise, and provide informed consent.
items.limitation: 短期KT值和Lysholm评分存在中高异质性，部分证据质量较低，需谨慎解释。
items.limitationEn: Short-term KT values and Lysholm scores showed moderate to high heterogeneity, and some evidence quality was low, requiring cautious interpretation.

items.title: Prediction model for timing of independent walking on varied surface conditions in patients with early subacute stroke: A multicenter prospective study.
items.summary: A multicenter prospective observational study of 168 subacute stroke patients developed and internally validated a Cox proportional hazards model to predict independent walking on varied surfaces, achieving cumulative FAC 5 rate of 51% by week 20, with AUCs from 0.86 to 0.92.
items.curatedReason: 这项模型预测亚急性卒中患者在不同表面上独立行走的时间，内部验证表现良好，51% 患者在第20周达到FAC 5。你可以将其作为一个辅助工具，初步估计患者的康复潜力并与患者沟通预期，但记得这毕竟是观察性研究，在外部验证前不可盲目采信。
items.titleZh: 预测亚急性卒中患者在不同表面上独立行走时间的预测模型：一项多中心前瞻性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对168名亚急性卒中患者的多中心前瞻性观察研究，开发并内部验证了一个预测在多种表面上独立行走时间的Cox比例风险模型，第20周时FAC 5累积实现率为51%，AUC值介于0.86至0.92。
items.curatedReasonEn: This model predicts the time to independent walking on varied surfaces for subacute stroke patients, with good internal validation and 51% reaching FAC 5 by week 20. You can use it as an auxiliary tool for initial estimation of rehabilitation potential and patient expectation management, but remember this is an observational study; do not rely on it solely before external validation.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性设计，且模型在临床实施前需要外部验证。
items.limitationEn: This study is an observational design, and the model requires external validation before clinical implementation.

items.title: Music-based interventions in adult stroke rehabilitation: a narrative review of clinical applications, proposed mechanisms, and implementation.
items.summary: A narrative review synthesizing music-based interventions in adult stroke rehabilitation found consistent evidence for rhythmic auditory stimulation in gait and selected music-supported upper-limb programs, with potential for melodic intonation therapy in nonfluent aphasia, highlighting the need for defined musical ingredients and functional targets.
items.curatedReason: 音乐干预并非包治百病，在卒中康复中，目前只有节律听觉刺激（Rhythmic Auditory Stimulation）对步态和特定音乐支持的上肢训练有较一致的证据。对非流利性失语症，旋律语调疗法（Melodic Intonation Therapy）有潜力。切勿盲目引入，务必明确音乐的"成分"和具体的功能目标，而非泛泛而谈。
items.titleZh: 成人卒中康复中的音乐干预：临床应用、作用机制和实施的叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 一项关于成人卒中康复中音乐干预的叙述性综述发现，节律性听觉刺激对步态和特定音乐支持的上肢程序有较一致的证据，旋律语调疗法对非流畅性失语症有潜力，强调需明确音乐成分与功能目标。
items.curatedReasonEn: Music interventions are not a panacea. In stroke rehabilitation, consistent evidence exists primarily for rhythmic auditory stimulation in gait and selected music-supported upper-limb programs. Melodic intonation therapy shows potential for nonfluent aphasia. Do not introduce music interventions indiscriminately; clearly define the 'musical ingredients' and specific functional targets, rather than making vague claims.
items.limitation: 本研究为叙述性综述，未进行全面的文献检索、偏倚风险评估或定量汇总。
items.limitationEn: This study is a narrative review, not undertaking exhaustive retrieval, formal risk-of-bias assessment, or quantitative pooling.

items.title: Effects of adding gait retraining with visual feedback to resistance-balance training on kinematics, centers of pressure, and proprioception in individuals with chronic ankle instability: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=45) found that adding gait retraining with visual feedback to resistance-balance training significantly improved proprioception (p=0.001, η²=0.34 for 15° joint position sense), mediolateral center of pressure (p=0.001, η²=0.42), and ankle kinematics in individuals with chronic ankle instability.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT表明，在阻力-平衡训练中加入视觉反馈步态再训练，能显著改善慢性踝关节不稳患者的本体感觉、压力中心和踝关节运动学。如果你在处理这类患者，这提示你可以考虑将此类综合训练纳入康复方案，以获得更全面的改善。
items.titleZh: 在慢性踝关节不稳患者的阻力-平衡训练中加入视觉反馈步态再训练对运动学、压力中心和本体感觉的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=45）发现，在慢性踝关节不稳患者的阻力-平衡训练中加入视觉反馈步态再训练，能显著改善本体感觉（15°关节位置感误差p=0.001, η²=0.34）、内外侧压力中心（p=0.001, η²=0.42）和踝关节运动学。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT indicates that adding gait retraining with visual feedback to resistance-balance training significantly improves proprioception, center of pressure, and ankle kinematics in individuals with chronic ankle instability. If you are treating such patients, this suggests you could consider incorporating this combined training into your rehabilitation protocols for more comprehensive improvements.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（45例），且未报告长期随访效果。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (45 participants) and did not report long-term follow-up effects.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Precision rehabilitation, from foundational concepts to contemporary perspectives: a mixed-methods scoping review
items.summary: A mixed-methods scoping review of 49 articles and 16 knowledge user interviews mapped foundational concepts of precision rehabilitation, defining it with a unique emphasis on personalization, function, and participation, distinguishing it from precision medicine while identifying specific facilitators and barriers to its implementation.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述提供了精准康复的初步定义，并指出了其在康复领域的独特之处——更强调个性化、功能和参与。你可以利用这些见解来思考如何在你的临床实践中更好地融入精准康复的理念，尤其是在技术应用和数据收集方面，同时关注患者的社会心理因素。
items.titleZh: 精准康复：从基本概念到当代视角——一项混合方法范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含49篇文章和16次知识用户访谈的混合方法范围综述，绘制了精准康复的基本概念图谱，并将其定义为独特强调个性化、功能和参与，使其与精准医学区别开来，同时识别了实施中的具体促进因素和障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review provides a preliminary definition of precision rehabilitation and highlights its unique emphasis on personalization, function, and participation in rehabilitation.
